remarks: Gorgeous and fresh Historic Warehouse Condo in downtown Buffalo. This 1 bedroom unit has an open floor plan and has high ceilings. The bedroom has a large walk in closet and there is an oversized bath featuring a walk in shower, and soaking tub. Finishes inside are all high end with a stunning kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite counters, breakfast bar all overlooking the great room. This open floorplan is highlighted by a window wall bringing in tons of light and a gas fireplace. There is also in unit laundry, central air, recently updated mechanicals. This is a secure building and has 2 gated parking areas. You are within walking distance to a many restaurants, sporting events, Canal Side, Main St Theater District, and the Medical Corridor. The unit also comes with a storage unit in the basement. Don't miss your opportunity here! This unit has been competitively priced and is ready for you to move in without any work.
